name: Xiamen ITG Group Corp.,Ltd
summary: Xiamen ITG Group Corp., Ltd., established in 1980 and headquartered in Xiamen, China, primarily operates through three distinct business segments: supply chain management, property development, and financial services. The company's comprehensive supply chain operations encompass the global trade of a wide array of products. This includes various metals like steel, iron ore, silicon, magnesium ingots, magnesium alloys, and their derivative products, as well as precious and basic metals, which it also handles through leasing, swaps, and spot transactions. It also deals in energy commodities such as thermal and metallurgical coal, forest pulp, paper, rubber, petrochemicals, and agricultural goods. Its portfolio extends to textile fabrics, apparel, medical devices, and maritime vessels with their associated materials and equipment. Furthermore, ITG manufactures and exports footwear and handbags, and offers integrated logistics support, encompassing ship management, agency services, brokerage, and warehousing. In real estate, the group undertakes the development and construction of diverse property types, including urban centers, industrial parks, and leisure and tourism destinations. It also provides related property management services. Its financial services division offers a range of specialized solutions, including brokerage for commodity and financial futures, futures investment advisory, asset management, and risk management. Additionally, the company engages in futures hedging and broader financial investment activities.
